data.text: Kuch Aur Quranic Jama ke Alfaaz

Bahut se jama ke alfaaz hain jo [ا] aur [ت] par khatam hote hain jaise [الْجَنَّات] aur [الْبَرَكَات]. Yeh Quranic alfaaz aam taur par 'jama' yaani bahut si jagahon ya bahut si cheezon ka matlab dete hain.
Yeh alfaaz yaad kar lein. Alfaaz ke aakhir mein (ات) unhe doosre jama ke alfaaz se alag karta hai.
Agar yeh jama ke alfaaz (الـ) se shuru na hon to unke aakhiri harf par tanween aayegi. Yaani agar (الـ) ho to tanween nahin, aur agar na ho to tanween hogi.

data.text: Darj zail misaalein dekhein:
Upar ke misaalon se zahir hai ke (وَ) ka matlab 'aur' hai. Yeh do alfaaz ko jodta hai. (وَ) ke pehle aur baad ke alfaaz par tino tarah ki harakat aa sakti hain.
Aap in Quranic alfaaz ko khud samajh sakte hain:
Kabhi kabhi (وَ) teen alfaaz ko jodne ke liye bhi istemal hota hai. Niche diye gaye Quranic fiqron ko padhiye jinhe aap khud samajh sakte hain.
Kabhi kabhi (وَ) char ya paanch alfaaz ko bhi jodta hai. Niche diye gaye Quranic fiqron ko padhiye aur unka tarjuma kijiye. Aap bina kisi madad ke unhe samajh sakte hain.

Shuru mein (ال) ke baghair Quran-e-Majeed ke alfaaz ke aakhir mein 'o' ya 'u' (Pesh) ya do pesh (Tanween) aate hain. Aise alfaaz aam taur par kisi cheez ki sifat (attribute) bayan karte hain.
Kabhi kabhi shuru mein (ال) ke baghair do ya zyada Quranic alfaaz ko bhi (وَ) ke sath joda jata hai. Aap in fiqron ko aasani se samajh sakte hain.

data.text: Darj zail alfaaz ko 'hai' ke saath samjhein aur tarjuma karein:
Jab koi lafz bina (ال) ke istemaal ho to uska mafhoom 'any/a' hota hai. Lekin jab woh jumle mein ata hai to uska tarjuma 'hai' (is) se hoga.
Darj zail Quranic fiqron aur aayaton ka tarjuma khud kijiye.
Darj zail Quranic fiqron aur aayaton ka tarjuma khud kijiye.

Quran-e-Majeed mein jumle ke aakhir mein aane wale alfaaz jo baghair (ال) ke hote hain (tanween ke sath), aam taur par Allah Ta'ala ki sifaat par mushtamil hote hain. Allah ke naam ke baad baghair (ال) ke sifat aati hai (jaise غَفُورٌ) to yeh ek mukammal jumla banta hai.
Kabhi kabhi Allah ke naam ke baad baghair (وَ) ke do sifaat lagataar aati hain. Aisi soorat mein inka tarjuma ek sath kiya jayega.

data.text: Jis tarah aap ab in Quranic ayaat ka kuch hissa khud samajhne ke qabil ho gaye hain, usi tarah jab aap aage ke darsoon mein aur alfaaz seekh lein ge, tab Quran-e-Pak ki poori aayaat ka tarjuma aasaani se kar sakenge. In Sha Allah.
Darj zail misaalein dekhein:

Upar zikr kiye gaye tamam Quranic alfaaz ke aakhir mein (ة/ـة) hai. Aise tamam alfaaz Arabic mein muzakkar ke muqaabile mein muannath hote hain aur in alfaaz ke liye ism-e-ishaarah (هٰذِهِ) hoga. Kuch aise alfaaz bhi hain jin ke aakhir mein (ة/ـة) nahin hai lekin Arabic mein unhe muannath maana jaata hai jaise (جَهَنَّمُ), (نَارٌ), (سَمَاءٌ), (أَرْضُ).
Ab aap darj zail jumloon ko khud samajh aur tarjuma kar sakte hain.
Door ki muannath cheez ke liye ism-e-ishaarah (تِلْكَ) hota hai. Darj zail Quranic jumloon ko khud samjho aur tarjuma karo.

(تِلْكَ) aam taur par door ki muannath cheez ke liye istemal hoti hai, lekin Quran-e-Pak mein zyada tar 'yeh' ki jagah istemal hoti hai aur isi mafhoom mein samajhna chahiye. Upar aapne 'woh' se tarjuma kiya. Ab dobara tarjuma karein aur 'yeh' istemal karein.

Agar (تِلْكَ) ya (هٰذِهِ) ke baad aane wala lafz (الـ) se shuru ho jaise (الشَّجَرَة, النَّارُ) toh jumla mukammal nahin hota, kyunki (هٰذِهِ) aur (الـ) se shuru hone wale lafz ka milap mafool (mubtada ya khabar) bana deta hai. Is liye tarjuma mein 'hai' nahin aayega.
Di gayi mithaal ko samne rakh kar ab darj zail jumloon ko khud samjho aur tarjuma karo.

Quran-e-Pak ko samajhne ke liye alfaaz, mukhtalif qism ke jumle, muhaavre aur chand zaroori qawaid jaanna zaroori hai. Is kitab mein In Sha Allah aap yeh sab cheezein aahista aahista aur aasaani ke saath seekhein ge.
